description: Áreas de Salvaguarda às Cabeceiras de Aeroportos e Aeródromos (PSOEM-Açores) is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Secretaria Regional do Mar e das Pescas / Governo dos Açores. Este conjunto de dados geográficos representa a Condicionante "Áreas de Salvaguarda às Cabeceiras de Aeroportos e Aeródromos" na Região Autónoma dos Açores, de acordo com a secção A.6 (Vol. Coverage: Secretaria Regional do Mar e das Pescas / Governo dos Açores. The publisher named on the listing is Secretaria Regional do Mar e das Pescas / Governo dos Açores. Its keywords include rcm-136-2024, srmp-gra, msp, condicionantes, cartografia-oficial, oceanos. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
